input_messages.content: Hello! I'm having trouble sending MMS messages from my phone for the past few hours. I would like to get this fixed so I can send picture messages again. Can you help me with that?
My phone number is 555-123-2002, and my name is John Smith. I hope that helps you find my account.
The status bar on my phone shows poor signal strength with 2G network, mobile data is enabled, and my battery is at 80%. Also, my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. What should I do next?

I changed the network mode to prefer 4G or 5G, and now my phone shows excellent signal strength on 5G with mobile data enabled. However, my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. What else can we try? I'm getting a bit frustrated with this.

The APN name on my phone is "internet," and the MMSC URL for picture messages is set to "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." I understand these are technical settings and usually best left unchanged. What should I do next?
Wi-Fi Calling on my phone is currently turned OFF. What should I check or do next?
The messaging app on my phone has permission for storage and phone. It does not list SMS permission. Should I try to grant the SMS permission to the messaging app?

I granted the SMS permission to the messaging app, and now it has both storage and SMS permissions. But unfortunately, it still cannot send MMS messages. What else can we try? This is quite frustrating.

I restarted my phone as you suggested. After the restart, my phone still shows excellent 5G signal with mobile data enabled, but my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. What should I do next? I'm really hoping we can fix this soon.

The speed test failed because there is no data connection. However, VPN is turned off and Data Saver mode is also off. It seems like my mobile data is not actually working even though it shows enabled. What should I do next?

Airplane mode is off, my SIM card is active, and my phone is connected to a 5G cellular network with excellent signal strength. Mobile data is enabled, and data roaming is also enabled. Wi-Fi is off and not connected.

Yes, I am currently outside my home network area; I am traveling abroad in France. What should I do next?

I ran the speed test again, and now my data connection is working very fast at 275 Mbps. I also checked, and my messaging app can now send MMS messages. It looks like the issue is fixed! Thank you for your help.

No, that's all I needed help with today. Thank you very much for your patience and assistance. I really appreciate it. Have a great day! 

###STOP###

If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.

Remember: The goal is to create realistic, natural conversations while strictly adhering to the provided instructions and maintaining character consistency.

Hello! I'm having trouble sending MMS messages from my phone for the past few hours. I would like to get this fixed so I can send picture messages again. Can you help me with that?
I can help with that. First, I need to identify your account. Please give me the phone number on your line, or your customer ID. You can also give me your full name and date of birth.
My phone number is 555-123-2002, and my name is John Smith. I hope that helps you find my account.

Thanks, John. I found your account and your line 555-123-2002. It's active, and its data usage is within your plan limit. Next I'll walk you through some checks on your phone.

Please do these two things and tell me what each one shows:
1. Run **check_status_bar**. It shows your signal strength, network type (such as 5G or 4G), and whether airplane mode, mobile data, and Wi-Fi are on.
2. Run **can_send_mms**. It checks whether your messaging app can send MMS messages.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Your messaging app cannot send MMS messages.
The status bar on my phone shows poor signal strength with 2G network, mobile data is enabled, and my battery is at 80%. Also, my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. What should I do next?

Your phone is on a 2G network, and 2G is generally too slow for MMS. Please change your network mode:

Run **set_network_mode_preference** with the mode `"4g_5g_preferred"`. This lets your phone connect to 4G or 5G.

Then check the status bar again and try sending an MMS. Let me know what you see.

Preferred Network Mode set to: 4g_5g_preferred
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Your messaging app cannot send MMS messages.

I changed the network mode to prefer 4G or 5G, and now my phone shows excellent signal strength on 5G with mobile data enabled. However, my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. What else can we try? I'm getting a bit frustrated with this.

I'm sorry this is taking a while. Your signal and network are good now, so let's check the other common causes of MMS problems.

Please run **check_apn_settings**. It shows your APN name and the MMSC URL, which your phone needs to send picture messages. Tell me exactly what it shows, including whether the MMSC URL is set.

Current APN Name: internet
MMSC URL (for picture messages): http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc
(These are technical settings, usually best left unchanged.)

The APN name on my phone is "internet," and the MMSC URL for picture messages is set to "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." I understand these are technical settings and usually best left unchanged. What should I do next?

The MMSC URL is set, so the APN settings look fine. Next I want to check whether Wi-Fi Calling is interfering with MMS.

Please run **check_wifi_calling_status** and tell me whether Wi-Fi Calling is ON or OFF.
Wi-Fi Calling is currently turned OFF.
Wi-Fi Calling on my phone is currently turned OFF. What should I check or do next?

Wi-Fi Calling is off, so that isn't the cause. Next I'll check your messaging app's permissions.

Please run **check_app_permissions** with app_name="messaging". Tell me which permissions it lists as granted, especially **storage** and **sms**.
App 'messaging' has permission for: storage, phone.
The messaging app on my phone has permission for storage and phone. It does not list SMS permission. Should I try to grant the SMS permission to the messaging app?

Yes. The messaging app needs both storage and SMS permissions to send MMS, and SMS is the one it's missing.

Please run **grant_app_permission** with app_name="messaging" and permission="sms". Then run **check_app_permissions** again to confirm that storage and sms are both listed. Try sending an MMS after that and tell me what happens.

Success. Permission 'sms' granted to app 'messaging'.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
App 'messaging' has permission for: sms, storage, phone.
Your messaging app cannot send MMS messages.

I granted the SMS permission to the messaging app, and now it has both storage and SMS permissions. But unfortunately, it still cannot send MMS messages. What else can we try? This is quite frustrating.

I'm sorry about the frustration. We've now covered the network mode, APN settings, Wi-Fi Calling, and app permissions. Some of those changes only fully take effect after a restart.

Please run **reboot_device** to restart your phone. Once it's back on, run **can_send_mms** and try sending a picture message. Tell me what happens.

Restarting network services...
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Your messaging app cannot send MMS messages.

I restarted my phone as you suggested. After the restart, my phone still shows excellent 5G signal with mobile data enabled, but my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. What should I do next? I'm really hoping we can fix this soon.

I'm sorry this is still not working. The MMS guide says picture messaging needs working mobile data, so I want to confirm your data connection is working.

Please run **run_speed_test** and tell me the result. Also run **check_vpn_status** and **check_data_restriction_status**, and tell me what each one shows.
Speed test failed: No Connection.
VPN is turned OFF.
Data Saver mode is OFF.

The speed test failed because there is no data connection. However, VPN is turned off and Data Saver mode is also off. It seems like my mobile data is not actually working even though it shows enabled. What should I do next?

Thanks, that explains why MMS still fails. MMS needs a working data connection, and yours isn't connecting even though mobile data shows as enabled. Your data usage (8.7 GB of 15 GB) is within your plan limit, so that isn't the cause.

Please run **check_network_status**. Tell me what it shows for airplane mode, signal strength, network type, mobile data, and data roaming.

Are you currently outside your home network area, for example traveling abroad?

Airplane mode is off, my SIM card is active, and my phone is connected to a 5G cellular network with excellent signal strength. Mobile data is enabled, and data roaming is also enabled. Wi-Fi is off and not connected.

Yes, I am currently outside my home network area; I am traveling abroad in France. What should I do next?
Your phone has data roaming on, but your line's roaming is off on our side. That's why mobile data and MMS aren't working abroad. I'll enable it now.
Roaming enabled successfully

I've enabled roaming on your line 555-123-2002 at no cost.

Please do the following:
1. Run **run_speed_test** again to see whether your data connection works now.
2. Run **can_send_mms** and try sending a picture message.

If the data still doesn't connect, restart your phone with **reboot_device** and test again. Let me know what you see.
Speed Test Result: 275.00 Mbps (Excellent). Connection is very fast.
Your messaging app can send MMS messages.

I ran the speed test again, and now my data connection is working very fast at 275 Mbps. I also checked, and my messaging app can now send MMS messages. It looks like the issue is fixed! Thank you for your help.

That's good news, John. Your data connection works and you can send MMS again. The cause was that roaming wasn't enabled on your line while you're in France. I've enabled it at no cost.

Is there anything else I can help you with today?

No, that's all I needed help with today. Thank you very much for your patience and assistance. I really appreciate it. Have a great day!
